verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a backend-as-a-service, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk or batch API for creating, updating, or deleting many rows, files, or users at once. The CLI and MCP server docs only mention generic resource management, and one-click migrations and messaging topics are adjacent features rather than bulk operations on items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
